mapper.select: SELECT question_id, generation_job_id, matrix_row_id, ccct_item_id, custom_learning_level_id, question_type, allocation_snapshot, created_at FROM edu.question_generation_provenance WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.question_generation_provenance (question_id, generation_job_id, matrix_row_id, ccct_item_id, custom_learning_level_id, question_type, allocation_snapshot, created_at) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{generationJobId}, #{matrixRowId}, #{ccctItemId}, #{customLearningLevelId}, #{questionType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$QuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, CAST(#{allocationSnapshot} AS jsonb), NOW())
